sections.Tests to add:
### Tests to add

- `tests/cliResultCommandRegistry.test.ts` (static): every `RESULT_COMMANDS` and `NON_RESULT_COMMANDS` path exists in `buildCommandInventory(program)`; no path is in both; every inventory path whose description matches score, level, verdict, complian, certif, passport, attest, assurance, bundle, readiness, benchmark, badge or leaderboard (case-insensitive) is in one of the lists.
- `tests/cliClaimLabels.e2e.test.ts`: build one seeded temp workspace (`amc init` plus a signed diagnostic run, using the helpers existing e2e tests use); run every registry path with `node dist/cli.js` and `AMC_CLAIM_LABELS_STRICT=1`, preferring `--json`; assert exit code is never 70; when it is 0, text contains "Claim: " and JSON has `claimKind` in `CLAIM_KINDS` and a `statusDimensions` that parses. Commands that need fixtures the workspace lacks must refuse cleanly (exit not 0 and not 70); list them by name in the test. Use `describe.concurrent` with a bounded concurrency.
- Exact cases: `amc domain assess --example` → synthetic_example; `amc domain pack run --baseline --json` → self_reported with `eligibleLevel` at most 1; `amc quickscore --auto` on the seeded workspace → never independently_reviewed; a 1.1.1 run fixture → "Legacy (1.x), self-reported".
- Report snapshots: each listed builder renders the legend and a claim kind per result.
- Hook: a dummy registered command that prints without a label exits 70 in strict mode and prints the fallback line otherwise.

Mutation checks: skip `installClaimLabelHooks` → the dummy strict case fails; drop one registry entry → the static coverage test fails.
sections.Acceptance criteria:
### Acceptance criteria

- The registry covers every inventory command the keyword test matches; each exclusion has a reason.
- Strict e2e: no registered command exits 70; every successful one prints "Claim: " and its JSON carries `claimKind` and `statusDimensions`.
- Each listed report builder renders a legend and per-result claim kinds (snapshots).
- Legacy fixtures read "Legacy (1.x), self-reported".
- No "Certified" level name in REPL or dashboard; P0-16 `pending` entries for P0-22 removed.
- `src/cli.ts` and the files with 1 line of headroom stay within budget; mutation checks recorded; full suite and checks pass; docs and changeset added.

sections.Risks and gotchas:
### Risks and gotchas

- Scripts that parse CLI text will see new lines; JSON changes are additive. Release notes (P0-34) must say so.
- `postAction` does not run after `process.exit(…)`. Registered commands that call `process.exit(0)` after printing bypass the hook; switch them to `process.exitCode`.
- The e2e file spawns about 160 commands; keep it separate so the focused suite stays fast.
- Never label a verification as `independently_reviewed` because a signature checked out.
